records.text: A Hakkari shadowcaster in Zul’Gurub, this spellcasting troll uses Mana Burn in combat.

A Zul’Gurub shadow hunter, this troll serves among the Gurubashi raiders. Its combat taunts boast of troll mojo, threaten to use a foe’s skull as ritual-altar decoration, and warn that its weapon is thirsty; it also shoots in combat.
A Hakkari blood priest among Zul’Gurub’s trolls, this combatant threatens to place a foe’s skull on a ritual altar and boasts that killing them will be easy. It also uses Dispel Magic in combat.
Zealot Lor’Khan is a named troll zealot in Zul’Gurub.
Zealot Zath is a named troll zealot in Zul’Gurub.
A Gurubashi axe thrower in Zul’Gurub, this raider boasts of troll mojo, threatens to decorate ritual altars with a foe’s skull, and says its weapon is thirsty. It uses Axe Flurry in combat.
A Gurubashi headhunter who fights for the tribe, taunting attackers with threats to adorn ritual altars with their skulls and boasts about killing them. In combat, the headhunter uses Whirling Trip.
A Gurubashi berserker, a fighter that goes into a frenzy when badly wounded.
A Gurubashi blood drinker that leeches blood at close range and drains life when badly hurt.

A Gurubashi champion who fights for the tribe, taunting attackers with threats to adorn ritual altars with their skulls and boasting that killing them will be easy. In combat, the champion uses Strike.
A beast of Zul'Gurub that spreads fear and taps souls; badly wounded, it goes into a frenzy.
A young Zulian cub, this beast can break away and flee for help when near defeat.
A powerful Zulian tiger, a beast of Zul'Gurub.
A powerful Zulian panther that rakes its prey.
The Bloodseeker bat rushes at newly engaged foes with Charge.
A Razzashi Serpent is a beast that uses Fatal Bite in combat.
A Razzashi Adder is a snake that uses Exploit Weakness and Venom Spit in combat.
A Razzashi Cobra is a snake that uses Poison in combat.
A Hooktooth Frenzy is a beast that uses Pierce Armor in combat.
Jin'do the Hexxer welcomes challengers to a deadly show, telling them to step right up and die. His greeting casts him as a taunting encounter adversary.
Bloodlord Mandokir threatens to feed challengers' souls to Hakkar, says he is watching his target, and warns against angering him. When his raptor falls, he flies into a rage.
The Sandfury Speaker is a Sandfury troll ambassador.
The Witherbark Speaker is identified as a Witherbark Troll Ambassador, a representative associated with the Witherbark.
The Bloodscalp Speaker is identified as a Bloodscalp Troll Ambassador, a representative associated with the Bloodscalp.
The Skullsplitter Speaker is the Skullsplitter troll ambassador.
The Vilebranch Speaker is the Vilebranch troll ambassador.
A Hakkari priest among Zul'Gurub's trolls, he threatens to adorn ritual altars with enemies' skulls and boasts that his weapon is thirsty. His taunts pair ritual violence with eager bloodshed.
Hakkari Witch Doctor boasts that troll mojo is strongest, threatens to decorate ritual altars with enemies’ skulls, and describes its weapon as thirsty for combat.
High Priest Venoxis has a theatrical encounter voice: he calls for the coils of hate to unfurl during transformation, then greets death with “Ssserenity...at lassst!”
High Priest Thekal calls on Shirvallah for rage in battle. At death, he declares that Hakkar no longer binds him and welcomes peace, revealing his release from Hakkar’s control.

High Priestess Mar'li calls on Shadra, the web mistress, to make her an avatar and rallies her brood to defend itself. At death, she says Hakkar no longer controls her and thanks the mortals for her release.
High Priestess Jeklik calls on Lord Hir'eek for wings of vengeance, then commands fire against the invaders. At death, she curses Hakkar, showing her hatred of him even as she welcomes death.
Razzashi Venombrood is a venomous beast that uses Intoxicating Venom in combat.
A Gurubashi bat rider in Zul'Gurub. When it casts Unstable Concoction, it bursts into flame and a maddened look comes into its eyes.
A Withered Mistress is an undead Zul'Gurub combatant who casts Curse of Blood in combat.
The Sacrificed Troll is an undead troll found in Zul'Gurub.

Hakkar, the Soulflayer, claims divine authority in Zul’Gurub. He commands minions to defend Hakkari holy ground and the Altar of Blood, calling intruders infidels. He demands allegiance with the promise of less pain and threatens a reign of immeasurable cruelty over the world. The Zandalar regard him as an evil threat to their tribe.
A Razzashi Skitterer, a beast of Zul'Gurub.
An Atal'ai Mistress is a combatant who uses Snap Kick during combat.
A Voodoo Slave is a combatant who uses Lightning Blast during combat.

Zanza is a Loa of Zandalar who says he came in an ethereal form to aid his people and that Hakkar has no dominion over his soul. He recounts that high elves stole his magic during their conflict with the trolls of Zul'Aman, using it to enchant weapons and armor. He helps those who have helped the Zandalarian people.
A Zulian Stalker, a beast of Zul'Gurub.
A hostile Mad Servant of Zul'Gurub that threatens to make attackers into mojo and boasts that troll mojo is the strongest.

place_records.text: You are in Zul'Gurub, the Hakkari trolls' holy ground in Stranglethorn Vale. High Priest Venoxis, Jin'do the Hexxer and Hakkar the Soulflayer hold it, and Hakkar claims divine authority over the place. Razzashi serpents and Zulian crocolisks are its most numerous creatures. Zanza the Restless, a Loa of Zandalar, has come in an ethereal form and says Hakkar has no dominion over his soul.

You are in the Coil, the serpent temple of Zul'Gurub, where High Priest Venoxis calls for the coils of hate to unfurl. Razzashi serpents, adders and cobras coil through it, and Hakkari priests and Sandfury speakers serve beside him.

You are in the Altar of Hir'eek in Zul'Gurub, where High Priestess Jeklik calls on Lord Hir'eek for wings of vengeance. Bloodseeker bats fill the air, and Gurubashi bat riders, headhunters and Hakkari witch doctors keep the altar. Jeklik bears Hakkar no love.

You are in Shadra'zaar, the webbed temple of High Priestess Mar'li, who calls on Shadra, the web mistress. Her brood of Razzashi venombroods, skitterers and broodwidows crowds it, and Hakkari shadowcasters keep watch. Mar'li serves Hakkar against her will.

You are in the Hakkari Grounds of Zul'Gurub, where Bloodlord Mandokir rides with his raptor and threatens to feed challengers' souls to Hakkar. Razzashi raptors roam the grounds, and Gurubashi blood drinkers, champions and Hakkari priests stand guard.

You are in the Naze of Shirvallah in Zul'Gurub, where High Priest Thekal calls on Shirvallah for rage in battle, bound to Hakkar's service. Zulian tigers and their cubs prowl among Gurubashi axe throwers.
You are in the Temple of Bethekk, a panther-haunted temple of Zul'Gurub. Zulian panthers stalk its halls, kept by Hakkari shadow hunters and Gurubashi blood drinkers.

You are in the Bloodfire Pit of Zul'Gurub, where Jin'do the Hexxer welcomes all comers to his deadly show. Withered and Atal'ai mistresses attend him, and the pit holds sacrificed trolls and voodoo slaves.

You are in the Altar of the Blood God, the heart of Zul'Gurub, where Hakkar the Soulflayer claims divine authority and calls intruders infidels. Sons of Hakkar and soulflayers guard the altar, and Zulian crocolisks and hooktooth frenzies lurk nearby.
You are in Zanza's Rise, where Zanza the Restless stands among Razzashi serpents, mad servants and Razzashi adders.
You are in the Edge of Madness, a corner of Zul'Gurub where mad servants wander among Razzashi serpents and Hakkari blood priests.
You are in Pagle's Pointe, a quiet point in Zul'Gurub where Zulian crocolisks and hooktooth frenzies lurk.
